title: ASICS Marathon de Paris 2027 — Official homepage entry routes
publisher: ASICS Marathon de Paris (organiser official website)
claims: The official homepage counts down to the 2027 event on 4 April 2027 and identifies the event as the ASICS Marathon de Paris (50th edition).
Charity entries require fundraising for a partner charity; the homepage states a minimum fundraising target of €420 to be allocated an entry.
An official resale platform for bibs opens on 1 December 2026.
Runners coming from abroad can enter through partner tour operators that offer packages including an entry; corporate entries exist for companies.
The 2027 course is described as still under wraps and will be announced later on the official website.
